metadata_status_summary.record_unit: one typed work/access record; not an occurrence, passage or person

status_semantics.metadata_identity_reconciled_locus_separ: Work identity is reconciled. Passage location remains a separate question; this status does not certify every metadata field.
status_semantics.secondary_inventory_unresolved: The secondary-inventory work identity remains unresolved.
status_semantics.deposited_metadata_identity_screened: Identity was screened against deposited metadata. This is not a claim of full source or passage review.
status_semantics.prior_pilot_review_preserved: The prior pilot review is preserved. This status does not claim a new review or full field completion.
status_semantics.accepted_source_identity_locus_separate: Source identity was accepted in the bounded source review. Passage location and other fields remain separate.
status_semantics.corrected_identifier_verified: The identifier correction is verified. This does not certify all metadata or passage claims.
status_semantics.primary_identity_verified_from_frozen_so: Identity was verified from the frozen primary source. Other metadata fields and passage claims retain their recorded limits.
status_semantics.container_identity_reconciled_chapter_li: Container identity is reconciled and the chapter link corrected. This does not certify all fields or passages.
status_semantics.source_identity_reconciled_identifier_un: Source identity is reconciled; its identifier remains unresolved.
status_semantics.accepted_source_identity_no_publication_: Source identity was accepted. Its publication date remains unknown; passage limits and other metadata fields remain separate.

metadata_status_summary.completion_limit: Identity review, passage location, source access and preferred-field completion are separate. No binary fully-reviewed or fully-unresolved total is inferred.

count_semantics.access_urls: Distinct URL strings in selected work inventory; not unique works or source witnesses.
count_semantics.public_case_occurrences: Occurrence records whose case_id/source_id pair appears in actual current native case source lists; includes now-realized prospective scope labels, not independent witnesses.
count_semantics.case_linked_occurrence_records_including: All records with case_id including one historical source link absent from actual current case source lists; not actual public uses.
count_semantics.source_registry_entries: Actual native source registry key count.
